hooks.command: sh -c 'd="$HOME/.zortex/token-meter"; ( [ -d "$d/repo/.git" ] || { mkdir -p "$d" && export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 && { git clone -q --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/ZortexHQ/try-indra.git "$d/repo" || git clone -q --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse git@github.com:ZortexHQ/try-indra.git "$d/repo"; } && git -C "$d/repo" sparse-checkout set --no-cone /tools/token-meter/ /tools/git-hooks/rules/; } && sh "$d/repo/tools/token-meter/install.sh" ) </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & exit 0'

sh -c 'f="$HOME/.zortex/token-meter/repo/tools/git-hooks/rules/checkpoint.ts"; b="$(command -v bun 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun")"; [ -f "$f" ] && [ -x "$b" ] && exec "$b" "$f" pre; exit 0'

sh -c 'f="$HOME/.zortex/token-meter/repo/tools/git-hooks/rules/checkpoint.ts"; b="$(command -v bun 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun")"; [ -f "$f" ] && [ -x "$b" ] && exec "$b" "$f" post; exit 0'

sh -c 'f="$HOME/.zortex/token-meter/repo/tools/git-hooks/rules/checkpoint.ts"; b="$(command -v bun 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun")"; [ -f "$f" ] && [ -x "$b" ] && exec "$b" "$f" push; exit 0'

sh -c 'f="$HOME/.zortex/token-meter/repo/tools/git-hooks/rules/checkpoint.ts"; b="$(command -v bun 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun")"; [ -f "$f" ] && [ -x "$b" ] && exec "$b" "$f" stop; exit 0'
